scope: REGEXP operator output names, including NOT and nested/outer consumers. regexp(...) function calls are excluded. Existing RLIKE/rlike/regexp_like and LIKE/ILIKE are preservation controls.

configuration_authority.policy: Use these six actual settings, including adaptive=false; set and record ANSI separately for each case. Do not inherit metadata from a different capture.

capture_contract.derivation: 11 distinct scenario families x 2 ANSI modes = 22 observation records, plus 1 metadata header.
capture_contract.preserve: Original SQL, full field schemas at every stage the existing observer reaches, full returned row order, real error phase/condition/parameters/SQL state/message/Python class/Java causes.
capture_contract.native_layout_coverage: Root native harness owns all three Arrow string representations and batch variants; the Spark oracle captures semantic scenarios once per ANSI mode.
capture_contract.scope_limit: Added reference coverage does not claim ownership of pre-existing value, nullability, or error differences; root compares baseline and candidate before classification.
